description.value: Big Wheel Burger is a Victoria-based fast food chain that has operated as Canada's first carbon neutral fast food restaurant since 2011, sourcing 100% fresh BC beef and buns baked daily by Irene's Bakery. The Vic West location is one of five across greater Victoria, offering a menu built around local and sustainable suppliers including Berryman Brothers and Island Farms. Touring cyclists will find a range of dietary options including plant-based burgers, a dedicated gluten-free fryer, and vegan-available items.
